hilfe: Contracts. One contract runs for exactly ONE round.
Before the round three offers are on the board. You take one, or none -
a round without a contract is perfectly fine. Each offer says beforehand
what it pays and what it costs if you fail.
Settled at the end of the round, BEFORE the bag is sold and BEFORE the
target is taken off:
- before selling, so that holding jobs are possible at all. Otherwise
the automatic sale would clear out every 'keep 20 stones' contract.
- before the target, so a reward can never rescue a round that was
lost. A contract is a bonus, not the main event.
The penalty comes off the money you HAVE, and it is steep: 80 % of what
the contract would have paid. That is deliberate. At 10 % a contract was
worth taking whatever the odds, and then 'take one or none' was not a
choice at all. At 80 % you need to finish roughly FOUR OUT OF NINE for it
to be worth it - and on the round where you sit just above the target,
one failure is the round.
ONE ENTRY
id        for you, so a problem message can name it
text      what it says on the card. Placeholders:
%n%       the amount
%erz%     the ore
%t%       the seconds (holding jobs)
%grenze%  the line limit (frugal)
art       WHAT is measured, see the list below
menge          how big the task is in round 1 ...
menge_wachstum ... times this per round. 1.15 = 15 % more each round.
menge_vom_ziel instead of the two above: a share of the round target.
Everything counted in MONEY should use this - only that
keeps up when the target starts doubling.
dauer     seconds, for holding jobs. MUST be shorter than a round
(300 s in data/runden.json) - otherwise it cannot be done.
grenze    for 'frugal': at most this many executed lines.
erz       a fixed ore, or "*" for a random one. With "*" only ores
you have already held in your bag are picked, so a contract
is never impossible from the start.
lohn      share of the round target you get for it. 0.6 = 60 %.
strafe    share of the REWARD you lose if you fail. 0.80 = 80 %,
which is what every contract uses right now. It stays a
per-contract field, so the easy ones can be made gentler
again if that turns out to be too harsh.
braucht   skill tree key. Without it the contract is never offered.
ab_runde  not before this round.
THE KINDS
Counting - a number goes up and never falls back:
mined          blocks mined
mined_ore      blocks of one ore
earned         money from selling. The automatic sale at the end of the
round does NOT count - you have to sell yourself.
crafted        pieces processed
alloyed        pieces alloyed
assayed        ores examined
clean_streak   blocks in a row without a single wrong treatment. One
mistake and it starts over.
sold_above     pieces sold above their average price
Holding - the condition must hold for 'dauer' seconds WITHOUT A BREAK.
Let go once and the clock goes back to zero:
hold_ore       this many pieces of an ore in your bag
bag_purity     bag average at least this high
no_sell        sell nothing at all
furnaces_busy  no furnace standing idle
no_idle_block  never a block standing there with nobody working on it
Once - true at a single moment:
distinct_ores    this many different ores in the bag at once
distinct_states  this many different states at once
single_sale      one single sale at least this big
frugal           this much money with fewer than 'grenze' executed
lines. The only contract you cannot solve by waiting.

auftraege.text: Earn %n% by selling during the round
Mine %n% blocks in a row without one wrong treatment
Hold your bag above %n% %% purity for %t% seconds
Sell nothing at all for %t% seconds
Keep every furnace busy for %t% seconds without a break
Never let a block stand around for %t% seconds
Sell %n% pieces above their average price
Have %n% different ores in your bag at the same time
Have %n% different states in your bag at the same time
Earn %n% while running fewer than %grenze% lines
